name: Design
description: Creates intuitive, engaging user experiences that delight customers and drive business success

roles.name: UX Designer
roles.description: Designs intuitive and accessible user experiences that meet user needs and business objectives
responsibilities: Conduct user research and usability testing
Create user personas, journey maps, and experience flows
Design intuitive and accessible user interfaces
Ensure consistent and cohesive user experiences

roles.name: Visual Designer
roles.description: Creates compelling visual designs and maintains design consistency across platforms
responsibilities: Develop visual design systems and style guides
Create compelling visual assets and brand elements
Ensure design consistency across all platforms and channels
Maintain high standards for visual quality and aesthetics

roles.name: Design Strategist
roles.description: Aligns design decisions with business objectives and user needs
responsibilities: Align design decisions with business objectives and user needs
Establish design principles and best practices
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on design solutions

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive design strategy that aligns with business objectives and user needs.
Create user experience designs and flows based on the design strategy.
Develop visual designs and design systems that support the UX strategy.
Finalize the integrated design strategy with design principles and implementation guidelines.
